ideas.title: Macros: record and replay sequences of trainer actions
ideas.desc: Record trainer clicks/actions and replay them (with repeats and delays).

ideas.title: Settings profiles (e.g. speedrun, chaos, testing)
ideas.desc: Save and load whole sets of enabled options.

ideas.title: Favourite options (pin) on the first page
ideas.desc: Pin the most used options to your own tab.

ideas.title: Hotkeys for pages and macros
ideas.desc: Custom shortcuts that open specific tabs or run macros.

ideas.title: In-game update check
ideas.desc: Notice about a new build with a download link (no automatic file replacement).

ideas.title: English interface
ideas.desc: PL/EN language switch - English as the default, Polish as a translation.

ideas.title: Session stats: kills, items collected, distance, time
ideas.desc: A window with live game stats and totals for the session.

ideas.title: Automated tests: in-game simulation
ideas.desc: Later: automated tests that simulate things in Gothic (turn options on, check the effect) and report results.

ideas.title: Custom menu themes: editable and loadable style list
ideas.desc: Themes stored in files (colours, rounding, fonts), a list of ready styles and the option to load your own or share them.
